Tentang Pekerjaan

Management Development Program (MDP) adalah program karier yang dirancang untuk mempersiapkan future leaders di dunia perbankan. Selama program berlangsung, peserta akan mendapatkan pelatihan intensif, mentoring dari profesional berpengalaman, serta kesempatan mendalami berbagai fungsi bisnis untuk memahami proses kerja secara menyeluruh. Melalui kombinasi pembelajaran dan pengalaman langsung, peserta akan mengembangkan kemampuan analisis, problem solving, dan leadership, serta dipersiapkan untuk mengambil peran strategis dan melanjutkan karier sebagai karyawan tetap di perusahaan.

Persyaratan

• WNI berusia maksimal 24 tahun (S1) dan 26 tahun (S2)
• Pendidikan minimal S1 dari semua jurusan dengan IPK minimal 3.00
• Menyukai tantangan dan senang mempelajari hal-hal baru
• Mempunyai kemampuan komunikasi, analytical thinking, interpersonal, serta leadership yang baik
• Mampu berbahasa Inggris secara lisan dan tulisan
• Mampu berbahasa asing lainnya menjadi nilai tambah
• Bersedia ditempatkan di seluruh Indonesia

Role Purpose

Responsibilities:

• Plan and execute corporate sales activities for Indosat Business services (increase revenue & wallet share)
• Evaluate and create program to improve customer productivity in term of services usage.
• Orchestrate projects among internal functions, partners and customer
• Coordinate with Enterprise Sales Solution, Marketing, Product Development, Technical and other supporting functions concerning proposal preparation of offering solution and pricing that needed by customer.
• Coordinate with Major Events to retain customer and increase customer loyalty.
• Evaluate achievement of target production and revenue from Customer based on determined budget.
• Manage Team and ensure the Team achieve KPI target
• Conduct reporting of the sales activities performance
• Give feedback to Marketing, Product Development and Technical Function concerning trend of services need, market pricing & customer potential

Requirements

• Minimum bachelor’s degree
• min 3 years of B2B sales experience
• Having knowledge about B2B business model and sales methodology
• Good in English, oral and written.
• Good in communication, negotiation, presentation and report writing skills
• Good analytical thinking
• Demonstrated ability to build and maintain a strong sales pipeline
• Flexible and adaptable in under pressure situations and meet short and long term deadlines.
• Able to use Microsoft office (excel, ppt, doc, etc)
